description: This file implements the PipelineRunner class responsible for managing the execution of pipeline tasks, including handling signals (SIGINT/SIGTERM), optional garbage collection, and cleanup processes. It provides methods to run, cancel, and stop tasks, as well as configuring signal handling.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Manages the execution of pipeline tasks with lifecycle and signal handling.

methods.name: __init__( self, *, name: Optional[str] = None, handle_sigint: bool = True, handle_sigterm: bool = False, force_gc: bool = False, loop: Optional[asyncio.AbstractEventLoop] = None, )
methods.description: Initializes the PipelineRunner with optional signal handling and garbage collection settings.

methods.name: run(self, task: PipelineTask)
methods.description: Runs a given pipeline task asynchronously until completion.

methods.name: stop_when_done(self)
methods.description: Schedules all running tasks to stop when their current processes finish.

methods.name: cancel(self)
methods.description: Cancels all currently running tasks immediately.

methods.name: _cancel(self)
methods.description: Internal method to perform immediate cancellation of all tasks.

methods.name: _setup_sigint(self)
methods.description: Sets up signal handling for SIGINT (interrupt signal).

methods.name: _setup_sigterm(self)
methods.description: Sets up signal handling for SIGTERM (termination signal).

methods.name: _sig_handler(self)
methods.description: Handles signals by initiating cancellation of all tasks.

methods.name: _sig_cancel(self)
methods.description: Performs the cancellation process after a signal is received.

methods.name: _gc_collect(self)
methods.description: Performs garbage collection and logs the number of objects collected.
